introduction: I am a developer focused on building AI-enabled applications, reliable backend APIs, database-driven systems, and responsive web and mobile experiences. I work across application architecture, backend engineering, data management, and AI integration to turn ideas into practical software products.

My technical background bridges computational science, backend API engineering with FastAPI and Python, cross-platform mobile development with Flutter, and data engineering pipelines. I am passionate about crafting modular architectures, resilient database schemas, and intuitive digital interfaces.
